evidence.quote: I thought it would be helpful at this early stage to offer my views on capital regulation and the role that capital standards play in helping to advance the safety and soundness of banks
Our inability to predict such events would argue for a higher overall capital level than one based solely on historical experience.
We're starting from a good place because capital today is strong. I hope to have more to say about that review early in the new year.
